## Context / Problem

The user-level Copilot skills `rebar-implement`, `rebar-janitor`, and `rebar-debug`
(symlinked into `~/.copilot/skills/` from `examples/agent-skills/`) silently fail to
register in GitHub Copilot CLI, while `rebar-brainstorm` registers fine. Copilot CLI
enforces the Agent Skills spec's 1024-character `description` cap and a strict YAML
frontmatter parse, but drops non-conforming skills silently — no error, no warning
(github/copilot-cli#3494; YAML strictness in #1024). The three failing skills each hit a
trigger: `rebar-implement` (1327-char description) and `rebar-janitor` (1068-char) exceed
1024; `rebar-debug` (868-char) contains an unquoted `: ` (`discipline: write`) that breaks
the YAML plain scalar. Nothing in the repo guards against this regressing.

## Approach

Two parts. (1) Fix the three `SKILL.md` frontmatters: rewrite each `description` as a YAML
folded block scalar (`description: >-`), matching the packaged builtin skills' style, which
neutralizes colon/quote parse breaks, and trim the two over-cap descriptions to <= 1024
characters while preserving each skill's "Use when … or invokes /rebar-<name>" trigger.
(2) Add a deterministic CI lint that fails when any tracked `SKILL.md` has invalid
frontmatter — following the established `scripts/check_*.py` + `make lint` convention
(e.g. `scripts/check_docs_index.py` wired at `Makefile:185`, mirrored by
`tests/unit/test_check_docs_index.py`). This fits because it single-sources the rule the
same way existing structural gates do, and catches the failure class at commit/CI time
instead of silently at skill-load time.

## Scope

- `examples/agent-skills/rebar-implement/SKILL.md` — block-scalar + trim description to <=1024.
- `examples/agent-skills/rebar-janitor/SKILL.md` — block-scalar + trim description to <=1024.
- `examples/agent-skills/rebar-debug/SKILL.md` — block-scalar to fix the unquoted `: `.
- `scripts/check_skill_frontmatter.py` — new lint: for every `examples/agent-skills/*/SKILL.md`,
  assert the frontmatter parses as YAML, `description` is present, non-empty, and <= 1024
  characters, and `name` (when present) is <= 64 chars and matches `^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$`.
  Expose importable `check_file`/`main(argv)->int` returning exit code, printing findings.
- `tests/unit/test_check_skill_frontmatter.py` — new test mirroring the check-script pattern
  (importlib-loaded, `pytest.mark.unit`): the real tree passes; synthetic over-cap,
  empty-description, unparseable-YAML, and bad-name fixtures each fail.
- `Makefile` — invoke `python scripts/check_skill_frontmatter.py` from the `lint` target.

## Testing

- Happy path: `python scripts/check_skill_frontmatter.py` exits 0 on the committed tree
  (all four skills valid after the fix); the unit test asserts this via `chk.main([]) == 0`.
- Failure/edge paths (unit test, synthetic fixtures): a 1200-char description fails; an
  empty description fails; frontmatter with an unquoted `: ` that yields non-string/parse
  error fails; a `name` over 64 chars or violating the regex fails.
- Regression check: assert each real skill's parsed description length is <= 1024 and each
  file's frontmatter YAML-parses to a mapping with a string `description`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] All four `examples/agent-skills/*/SKILL.md` frontmatters parse as YAML to a mapping
      whose `description` is a non-empty string <= 1024 chars — verified by
      `python scripts/check_skill_frontmatter.py` exiting 0.
- [x] `rebar-implement`, `rebar-janitor`, and `rebar-debug` descriptions each still contain
      their `/rebar-<name>` invocation trigger — verified by grep in the unit test.
- [x] `scripts/check_skill_frontmatter.py` exists and, run standalone, exits non-zero with a
      clear message when given a fixture SKILL.md whose description exceeds 1024 chars —
      verified by the unit test's failure cases.
- [x] `make lint` invokes the new check — verified by grepping the `lint` target for
      `check_skill_frontmatter` and by `make lint` passing on the fixed tree.
- [x] The unit test `tests/unit/test_check_skill_frontmatter.py` passes under
      `pytest -m unit` (happy path + over-cap + empty + unparseable + bad-name cases).

## 2026-08-08 duplicate consolidation

Duplicate report: `1fa8-ebe0-8cca-4d89`.

Fresh resolution experiment on current `origin/main`: `copilot skill list --json` discovers `rebar-debug`, `rebar-implement`, and `rebar-janitor` from the personal Copilot skill directory—the exact three skills that the original defect silently dropped. The repository checker also reports `PASS: 4 SKILL.md file(s) have valid frontmatter.` This exercises the actual Copilot discovery boundary as well as the deterministic guard, so the original failure is no longer occurring.
